units.one_line: TypeScript SDK for dApps: requests E3 rounds, encrypts values to the committee key with proofs, and reads E3 state and events.

actors.name: InterfoldSDK
actors.role: facade for requests, key reads, encryption, output publishing, and event subscriptions

actors.name: ContractClient
actors.role: wallet and public client for the Interfold contract: request, cancel, publish output, read E3

actors.name: EventListener
actors.role: delivers typed logs through contract watchers or polling; polling skips watched types and emits fetched ranges in block/log order

actors.name: CommitteePublicKeyAssembler
actors.role: rebuilds the committee public key from its published chunks

state.name: tracked committee-key assemblies, up to 128 E3 IDs by default
poll cursor and generation; cursor advances only after the range fetch succeeds, and a restarted loop invalidates the old generation

key_types.name: E3RequestParams
key_types.what: committee size, input window, E3 program, param set, compute and custom params, fee cap

key_types.name: E3Stage
key_types.what: None, Requested, CommitteeFinalized, KeyPublished, CiphertextReady, Complete, Failed

key_types.name: BfvParams
key_types.what: threshold BFV parameters: degree, plaintext modulus, moduli, error variance

key_types.name: CiphertextOutputReference
key_types.what: proof-backed reference to the aggregate ciphertext on the data-availability layer

read_first.why: public surface: the names a dApp imports
the request method and what it calls
polling lifecycle: starts at the current block, then fetches and emits newly observed ranges
where the committee public key is read, from the ciphernode registry

units.one_line: The CRISP E3 program: selects each slot's valid ballot chain and adds the selected BFV ciphertexts into one encrypted tally.

key_types.name: InputRecord
key_types.what: one input as the selection step sees it: index, ciphertext hash, stored commitment, opaque metadata, recomputed commitment

key_types.name: Metadata
key_types.what: slot (20 bytes) and optional parent index, parsed from the 25 metadata bytes

key_types.name: InputPolicy
key_types.what: the leaf and select functions that the compute provider runs for a program

key_types.name: FHEProcessorInput
key_types.what: BFV params and the list of ciphertexts handed to the processor

units.one_line: Rust CRISP server: builds the census, requests rounds, relays votes, indexes Interfold events, asks for compute at the deadline, and records the tally.

state.name: round records, indexed logs, and input and output jobs in the sled database
rate-limit windows per caller and global

key_types.name: E3Crisp
key_types.what: CRISP round record kept in the store: status, program, options, inputs, votes

key_types.name: JobState
key_types.what: availability job states from Created through Committed, Ready, and Submitted, or Failed

key_types.name: WebhookPayload
key_types.what: program server callback: Completed with ciphertext, commitment, and proof, or Failed

key_types.name: ComputeProviderParams
key_types.what: compute provider parameters encoded into the E3 request

key_types.name: EtherscanClient
key_types.what: census discovery pages all log ranges and includes wallet, bonded and escrow delegates before checking snapshot voting power

read_first.why: entry point: opens the store, starts the availability worker, the indexer, and HTTP

indexer wiring: which chain events it handles

the program server callback enum derives Serialize and Deserialize
